guarded_patterns.explanation: The manager-side manifest-appset-ardenone-cluster already owns this tree; a second root Application creates duplicate ownership.

redirect.reason_template: Do not create another Application over ./k8s/ardenone-cluster. The centralized manifest-appset-ardenone-cluster is the sole root and its generated children target https://k3s-server-a.ardenone.com:6443.

guarded_patterns.example_content:
apiVersion: argoproj.io/v1alpha1
kind: Application
metadata:
  name: applications-ardenone-cluster
spec:
  source:
    path: ./k8s/ardenone-cluster
